svg.title: From a manifest to a running group, and back to stopped
svg.desc: Seven steps in order. First, find its manifest — from a registry pointer, the studio's own repository, or one you wrote yourself. Then approve: every command the studio will run is shown before anything runs. Then install: the repository is cloned at the pinned reference, then the build steps run and the weights arrive. Then launch, at which point the approval is re-checked and you are asked again only if a command changed. Then queued, waiting for a heavy slot or for a dependency — and a second heavy studio states what it would stop and asks first. Then starting and running: a port is assigned and the health check passes. Finally stop, which tears the group down in reverse order.
